description: This file defines a PHP trait 'QueryTrait' that provides workspace-specific helper methods for altering entity queries within Drupal, including constructor setup, query preparation with workspace context, and query simplicity checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the trait with entity type, conjunction, database connection, namespaces, workspace manager, and workspace information service.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the query to include workspace-specific conditions, such as joining workspace associations and setting metadata, based on active workspace and entity type support.

methods.name: isSimpleQuery
methods.description: Determines if the current query is simple, considering workspace metadata.
